biggest_catch: The referral must be a valid new member who hasn't been a Congressional Federal member in the past 24 months.
catches: A valid referral requires the individual to meet membership requirements, not have been a member with Congressional Federal in the past 24 months, and be 18 or older.
Cap: $50 gift card per valid referral, limit of 10 referrals ($500) per calendar year per member.
Only current members in good standing, ages 18 and older, are eligible to refer.
Offer subject to change without notice and may end at any time.

c1.evidence: Verifiable program on institution's official domain: Congressional Federal Credit Union's official referral page (congressionalfcu.org/refer-module) pays the referring member for valid referrals.

c2.evidence: Concrete per-referral payout: the referring member receives a $50.00 digital gift card for each valid referral, with a limit of 10 referrals ($500) per calendar year per member.

c3.evidence: Mechanism: the member enters their email to get a unique referral link (sharelink) and shares it with friends, family, or business contacts; after the referred person opens an account, both the referrer and the referred receive a $50 digital gift card.

c4.evidence: Timing: the $50 digital gift card is sent after the referred person opens an account (exact timing not further specified).

eligibility: Current Congressional Federal Credit Union members in good standing, ages 18 and older; the referred person must meet membership requirements and not have been a member in the past 24 months.
notes: Congressional Federal Credit Union now welcomes members across the DMV area (no longer limited to Capitol Hill). Distinct from R0797 (Xcel Energy utility rebate).
numeric_basis: Per-referral payout of a $50.00 digital gift card.
payout_quote: The referring member will receive a $50.00 gift card digitally for each valid referral as noted below with a limit of 10 referrals (or $500) paid out per calendar year per member.
payout_value_note: $50 digital gift card per valid referral.

s1.note: No upfront fee charged to the referrer.

s2.note: Referral is free; no cost to refer.

s3.note: Tax treatment not disclosed on the official page.

s4.note: Cap: limit of 10 referrals ($500) per calendar year per member.

s5.note: Program live on the current official page (observed 2026-09-23); offer subject to change and may end at any time.

s6.note: Referral mechanics stated on the official page: enter your email to get your unique referral link and share it with friends, family, and business contacts.

s7.note: Friend-side qualifying actions: meet membership requirements to join the credit union; the referred person must not have been a member in the past 24 months and must be 18 or older.

steps: Enter your email on the referral page to get your unique referral link.
Share the link with friends, family, or business contacts.
After the referred person opens an account, you both receive a $50 digital gift card (up to $500 per year).
timing: The $50 digital gift card is sent after the referred person opens an account.
